_comment: 98Reborn compatibility rules. For each PCI device the FIRST matching rule wins, so specific IDs come before broad device classes. match: 'id:VVVV:DDDD', 'id:VVVV:DDDD-DDDD' (range), 'vendor:VVVV', or 'class:CCSS[PP]' (prefix). cap: the best tier possible with this device (gold, silver, bronze, dev, none). level: ok, info, warn, block.

pci.reason: Period NVIDIA GPU: full 3D acceleration once you install its Windows 98 driver (NVIDIA's, not included).
NVIDIA GeForce FX/6/7-era GPU: full 3D acceleration once you install its Windows 98 driver (NVIDIA's, not included).
ATI Radeon-era GPU (up to X850): full 3D acceleration once you install its Windows 98 driver (ATI's, not included).
3dfx GPU: native Glide and Direct3D once you install its Windows 98 driver (not included).
Graphics adapter with no Windows 98 driver: 98Reborn installs a VESA driver for a true-colour 2D desktop (starts at 1024x768; change it in Display Properties). 3D runs in software only.
pci.fix: For hardware 3D in games, add a period PCIe card (GeForce 6/7 or Radeon X-series).

pci.reason: Secondary display controller: not used by Windows 98.
IDE/legacy-mode disk controller: supported natively by Windows 98.
SATA controller in AHCI mode: needs a third-party AHCI driver under Windows 98.
pci.fix: If your BIOS offers 'IDE', 'Compatible' or 'Legacy' SATA mode, use it for the Windows 98 disk.

pci.reason: Storage in RAID / Intel RST mode: Windows 98 can't see disks behind it.
pci.fix: Switch the SATA mode to AHCI or IDE in the BIOS (on an existing Windows install, enable AHCI drivers there first).

pci.reason: NVMe controller: on UEFI boots Windows 98 runs from NVMe in MS-DOS compatibility mode (slower disk access); a native driver is in development.
Realtek RTL8139 Ethernet: Windows 98 driver available.
Realtek RTL8111/8168 Ethernet: no driver is included; Realtek's old Windows 98 driver works on some chip revisions only.
pci.fix: Add a supported PCIe network card if you need networking in Windows 98.

pci.reason: Intel PRO/1000 (8254x) Ethernet: works with Intel's Windows 98 driver (not included).
Network adapter with no known Windows 98 driver: Windows 98 will be offline.
pci.fix: Fine for offline use. For networking, add a supported PCIe card (Intel PRO/1000 or Realtek 8139).

pci.reason: Wi-Fi adapter: Windows 98 has no drivers for modern Wi-Fi. Use Ethernet or stay offline.
Creative sound card: works with Creative's Windows 98 driver (not included).
AC'97 audio: Windows 98 drivers exist for most codecs (not included; install after setup).

HD Audio: 98Reborn installs WDMHDA, a generic HD Audio driver (playback, up to 48 kHz stereo). It works with most Realtek and VIA audio chips; others (IDT, Analog Devices, Cirrus Logic) may stay silent. It's young: report glitches.
pci.fix: For guaranteed sound, a PCIe or PCI Creative/C-Media card.

pci.reason: USB 2.0 (EHCI) controller: USB keyboards, mice and storage work in Windows 98.
USB 1.1 (OHCI) controller: supported natively.
USB 1.1 (UHCI) controller: supported natively.
USB 3 (xHCI) controller: driven by xHCI98, which 98Reborn installs (keyboards, mice, hubs; not USB drives yet).
